/* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.admin.mapper.AnnouncementMapper.selectAnnouncementList */ /* 공고 목록 조회 */
SELECT cap.ann_no AS annNo /** 공고번호 */ , cap.board_no AS boardNo /** 게시판번호 */ , cbi.board_nm AS boardNm /** 게시판명 */ , cbi.board_ty_cd AS boardTyCd /** 게시판유형코드 */ , cbi.apt_cmplex_no AS aptCmplexNo /** 아파트단지번호 */ , ac.apt_cmplex_nm AS aptCmplexNm /** 아파트단지명 */ , cap.ttl AS ttl /** 제목 */ , cap.cn AS cn /** 내용 */ , cap.wrtr_id AS wrtrId /** 작성자아이디 */ , cap.top_fix_yn AS topFixYn /** 상단고정여부 */ , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblancBgngDt /** 공고게시시작일 */ , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblancEndDt /** 공고게시종료일 */ , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrtBgngDt /** 모집시작일 */ , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrtEndDt /** 모집종료일 */ , TO_CHAR(cap.reg_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDttm /** 등록일시 */ , TO_CHAR(cap.mdf_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdfDttm /** 수정일시 */ , NVL(cap.inq_cnt, 0) AS inqCnt /** 조회수 */ , NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') AS delYn /** 삭제여부 */ , NVL(cap.opn_yn, 'Y') AS opnYn /** 공개여부 */ , cap.sbmsn_doc AS sbmsnDoc /** 제출서류내용 */ , cap.atch_file_id AS atchFileId /** 첨부파일ID */ , ac.dorojuso /** 상세주소 */
, NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(au.unit_cnt, 0)) FROM apt_unit au WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no ), NVL(ac.unit_cnt, 0)) total_unit_cnt /** 전체세대수 */
, NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rent_listing rl INNER JOIN apt_detail ad ON rl.ho_no = ad.ho_no INNER JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no AND rl.ann_no = cap.ann_no ), 0) supply_cnt /** 공급수 */
, NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rent_listing rl INNER JOIN apt_detail ad ON rl.ho_no = ad.ho_no INNER JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no AND rl.ann_no = cap.ann_no ), 0) || '/' || NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(au.unit_cnt, 0)) FROM apt_unit au WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no ), NVL(ac.unit_cnt, 0)) || '세대' supplyDisplay /** 공급표시 */
, CASE WHEN cap.atch_file_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END hasFileYn /** 첨부파일존재여부 */ , CASE WHEN cap.rcrt_bgng_dt IS NULL OR cap.rcrt_end_dt IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TRUNC(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt) THEN '예정' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) > TRUNC(cap.rcrt_end_dt) THEN '마감' ELSE '진행중' END AS statusNm /** 공고상태 */ FROM center_ann_board_post cap INNER JOIN center_board_instance cbi ON cap.board_no = cbi.board_no LEFT JOIN apt_complex ac ON cbi.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') = 'N'
AND LOWER(cap.ttl) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{searchTtl}) || '%'
AND cbi.apt_cmplex_no = #{searchAptCmplexNo}
AND cap.rcrt_bgng_dt >= TO_DATE(#{searchFrom}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND cap.rcrt_end_dt <= TO_DATE(#{searchTo}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND CASE WHEN cap.rcrt_bgng_dt IS NULL OR cap.rcrt_end_dt IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TRUNC(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt) THEN '예정' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) > TRUNC(cap.rcrt_end_dt) THEN '마감' ELSE '진행중' END = #{searchStatus}
ORDER BY cap.reg_dttm DESC

/* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.admin.mapper.AnnouncementMapper.selectAnnouncement */ /* 공고 상세 조회 */
SELECT cap.ann_no AS annNo , cap.board_no AS boardNo , cbi.board_nm AS boardNm , cbi.board_ty_cd AS boardTyCd , cbi.apt_cmplex_no AS aptCmplexNo , ac.apt_cmplex_nm AS aptCmplexNm , cap.ttl AS ttl , cap.cn AS cn , cap.wrtr_id AS wrtrId , cap.top_fix_yn AS topFixYn , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblancBgngDt , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblancEndDt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrtBgngDt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrtEndDt , TO_CHAR(cap.reg_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDttm , TO_CHAR(cap.mdf_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdfDttm , NVL(cap.inq_cnt, 0) AS inqCnt , NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') AS delYn , NVL(cap.opn_yn, 'Y') AS opnYn , cap.sbmsn_doc AS sbmsnDoc , cap.atch_file_id AS atchFileId , ac.dorojuso
, NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(au.unit_cnt, 0)) FROM apt_unit au WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no ), NVL(ac.unit_cnt, 0)) total_unit_cnt
, NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rent_listing rl INNER JOIN apt_detail ad ON rl.ho_no = ad.ho_no INNER JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no AND rl.ann_no = cap.ann_no ), 0) supply_cnt
, NVL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rent_listing rl INNER JOIN apt_detail ad ON rl.ho_no = ad.ho_no INNER JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no AND rl.ann_no = cap.ann_no ), 0) || '/' || NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(au.unit_cnt, 0)) FROM apt_unit au WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no ), NVL(ac.unit_cnt, 0)) || '세대' supplyDisplay
, CASE WHEN cap.atch_file_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END hasFileYn , CASE WHEN cap.rcrt_bgng_dt IS NULL OR cap.rcrt_end_dt IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TRUNC(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt) THEN '예정' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) > TRUNC(cap.rcrt_end_dt) THEN '마감' ELSE '진행중' END AS statusNm
FROM center_ann_board_post cap INNER JOIN center_board_instance cbi ON cap.board_no = cbi.board_no LEFT JOIN apt_complex ac ON cbi.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no WHERE cap.ann_no = #{annNo} AND NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') = 'N'

/* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.admin.mapper.AnnouncementMapper.updateAnnouncement */ /* 공고 수정 */
UPDATE center_ann_board_post SET ttl = #{ttl} /** 제목 */ , cn = #{cn} /** 내용 */ , sbmsn_doc = #{sbmsnDoc} /** 제출서류 */ , pblanc_bgng_dt = TO_DATE(#{pblancBgngDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , pblanc_end_dt = TO_DATE(#{pblancEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , rcrt_bgng_dt = TO_DATE(#{rcrtBgngDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , rcrt_end_dt = TO_DATE(#{rcrtEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , mdf_dttm = SYSDATE /** 수정일시 */ WHERE ann_no = #{annNo} AND NVL(del_yn, 'N') = 'N'
mapper.select:
/* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.admin.mapper.AnnouncementMapper.selectAptComplexList */ /* 단지 목록 조회 */
SELECT ac.apt_cmplex_no AS aptCmplexNo , ac.apt_cmplex_nm AS aptCmplexNm , ac.dorojuso AS dorojuso /** 상세주소 */ , NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(au.unit_cnt, 0)) FROM apt_unit au WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no ), NVL(ac.unit_cnt, 0)) AS unitCnt FROM apt_complex ac WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM center_board_instance cbi WHERE cbi.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no AND NVL(cbi.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) ORDER BY ac.apt_cmplex_nm
